## What changed

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `make verify` passes locally.
- [ ] English and Russian navigation/content are covered, when relevant.
- [ ] UI changes include desktop and mobile screenshots.
- [ ] Draft skills describe sources, permissions and limitations accurately.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, generated build output or local deployment records are included.

## Scope and risk

Note any data, routing, authentication or deployment impact. A source change does not authorize a production deployment.
